issue.description:
Observed 2026-10-03 on codinghome: with the default TMPDIR (/home/coding/.tmp/...) workspace discovery stops at /home/coding/.beads (not a bead-rs workspace), so cli_sync and mutating_command_event_contract fail every 'bead init'; with TMPDIR=/tmp the same happens at /tmp/.beads; under /build (a symlink) store::sqlite::tests::test_init_workspace fails 'result.root == root'. The global core.hooksPath secret-scanner hook also rejects the 'sync commit' fixture commit in mutating_command_event_contract (fixture data contains an AWS-key-shaped string). CI passes, so these hide real failures locally.
Fix: integration tests create workspaces with --skip-foreign-workspace or under a temp root guaranteed free of .beads ancestors; fixture git invocations set GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM to /dev/null and core.hooksPath to an empty dir; compare canonicalized paths in the sqlite init tests.
Acceptance: 'cargo test' green on codinghome under the default TMPDIR with the global hooks installed.
issue.notes: Completed and verified the host-isolation fix already committed in 378d39b, e4446a1, and f7c7af1. Integration fixtures consistently pass --skip-foreign-workspace; the mutating-command sync/commit fixture disables global and system Git config and uses an absolute empty core.hooksPath; SQLite init-root comparison canonicalizes both paths. Targeted checks in the shared checkout passed: cli_sync 7/7, mutating_command_event_contract 4/4, and SQLite init unit tests 5/5. Mandatory committed-state verification extracted HEAD to /var/tmp, then scripts/definition-of-done.sh ran cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test, and doctests; all passed with exit 0. The clean extraction was removed after success. git push reported Everything up-to-date; git rev-list origin/main..HEAD was empty. Worktree status was reviewed before staging; all listed changes were unrelated concurrent work and none was staged.

Scope: when an issue is claimed and update_issue / update_issue_in_tx (src/service/lifecycle.rs) is invoked with NO claim-epoch credential, the mutation is refused with Error::LeaseConflict mapping to exit code 4; status, assignee, and revision are unchanged and no event is published. - cargo test --test claim_epoch passes in the default suite, with the update leg of a_claimed_issue_rejects_every_credentialless_claimant_mutation demonstrating the refusal (exit 4, held status/assignee/revision unchanged, published event count unchanged).
